name: Plate Armor of the Deep
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 128, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 464
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 128, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 464
Aura moderate abjuration CL 11th
Slot armor; Price 24,650 gp; Weight 50 lbs.
Description
This +1 full plate is decorated with a wave and fish motif and often has tiny fins and scales worked into the design. Although the armor remains as heavy and bulky as normal full plate, the wearer of plate armor of the deep is treated as unarmored for purposes of Swim checks. The wearer can breathe underwater and can converse with any waterbreathing creature with a language.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, freedom of movement, tongues, water breathing; Price 13,150 gp
